title: Explain unavailable evidence
responsibility: Provides the notice shown while recorded evidence is absent, loading or failed.

inputs.name: evidenceNotice.status
inputs.description: The evidence state: idle, planned, unavailable, loading, ready or failed.

inputs.name: evidenceNotice.error
inputs.description: The backend failure text, used only for a failed read.

inputs.name: evidenceNotice.kind
inputs.description: The entity kind inserted into the planned-but-not-implemented notice.

outputs.name: unavailableEvidence
outputs.description: The notice that recorded runtime evidence is unavailable on this connection.

outputs.name: readingEvidence
outputs.description: The notice that recorded evidence is being read.

outputs.name: evidenceNotice
outputs.description: Null for ready evidence. Otherwise a text notice with alert true only for failed reads. Planned and unavailable states have specific explanations; idle and loading use the reading notice.
